projects.name: StockWise
projects.desc: Full-stack autonomous algorithmic trading platform that automates trade execution, manages risk, and delivers real-time portfolio insights. Built with Next.js/React dashboard, Node.js backend, and AWS infrastructure for 24/7 operation with minimal manual intervention.

projects.name: Wearable Acoustic Monitor
projects.desc: Patented IoT-based acoustic monitoring & alert system (Indian Patent No. 202641062287). Wearable device with ESP8266 learns user's sound threshold via double-tap calibration, delivers vibration alerts, and sends real-time Telegram Bot notifications to caregivers. Validated over 100+ trials.

projects.name: Deep Packet Inspection Engine
projects.desc: High-performance C++ network traffic analysis & filtering system with a custom PCAP parser, 5-tuple flow tracking, and multithreading achieving ~196K packets/sec. TLS/SNI-based classifier identifies 20+ applications across HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, TLS & QUIC. 100% classification accuracy on 231K packets with zero data loss.
